notes.title: Games For Change Finalist!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce Radio General has been nominated as a finalist for the 2021 Games For Change awards! https://festival.gamesforchange.org/festival/festival-awards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912792/fd8b8bd76ddfc4a277607e5307322b98a734e2cc.png[/img]

You can also vote for Radio General in the People's Choice awards: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/SKZQRHT

Watch the awards live on July 12: https://hopin.com/events/games-for-change-virtual-festival-2021


MORE INFO:
Games for Change awards are designed to highlight games that achieve some form of social good, such as education, sparking important conversations, highlighting social issues or promoting empathy.

Radio General is first and foremost a strategy game, but it also places a heavy emphasis on education. We use hundreds of real historical photos and videos to teach players about real battles, and are one of the only games to cover Canadian history during the war. Currently Radio General is being used in local highschools to teach Canadian history during WW2, and we give out free keys for educational purposes.

Lastly, Radio General is also one of the rare games to promote empathy and discuss the actual human cost of war. Other RTS and wargames have you throw away hundreds if not thousands of digital lives during a mission, and the only acknowledgement given to this is your score screen at the end. In Radio General, you personally review casualty reports, and have to write letters home - how do you tell a mother their son won't be coming home?

In short, Radio General was nominated due to its educational focus and its unique depiction of the human cost of war.

notes.title: Remembrance Day free soundtrack and sale!
notes.notes:
Originally called “Armistice Day”, Remembrance Day in Canada commemorates the armistice agreement that ended the First World War on Monday, November 11, 1918, at 11 a.m.—on the eleventh hour of the eleventh day of the eleventh month.

Every year on November 11, Canadians pause in a moment of silence to honour and remember the men and women who have served, and continue to serve Canada during times of war, conflict and peace. We remember the more than 2,300,000 Canadians who have served throughout our nation’s history and the more than 118,000 who made the ultimate sacrifice.

To honour this occasion, we are releasing Radio General's soundtrack for free! Sit back, listen to those bombastic melodies, and give a thought or two to all those who fought in the war.

Soundtrack: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303970/Radio_General_Soundtrack/

Also, the game has a 50% discount!

notes.title: Patch 3.0 - D-Day Anniversary, two more missions!
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch v3.0[/h2]

Operation Overlord, or D-Day launched 76 years ago on the windy morning of June 6, 1944. To mark that momentous occasion, we've got some brand new content for you! Two new free campaign levels (each with new historical documents!) and variety of bug fixes. Why not mark the anniversary of the beginning of Europes liberation by recreating the event yourself, digitally?

[h3]MAJOR[/h3]
- NEW Melfa Pursuit mission (Italy). You are to pursue fleeing German units after penetrating the Hitler Line in Italy. Using scouts and snipers, avoid enemies and guide your small force to the rear poisition of Ceprano to dig in to prevent enemies from escaping.

- NEW Le Mesnils-Patry mission (France). After losing ground in the Juno Beach Counterattack in France, you are ordered once again to advance and retake lost ground. Prepare for an all-out brawl, with both sides fielding heavy armour and large numbers over a small area. This bloody battle was plagued with poor communication, and as such you will be working with an AI teammate in your assault. 

Both missions come with new historical photos, video and other documents. Check them out!


[h3]MINOR[/h3]
- Added Free-play and Challenge mode to Dieppe Revisited mission
- Increased tank health 25%, morale by 20%, tanks now move in squadrons of 6
- Added viewable barrage range stat for Artillery and Anti-tank guns
- Fixed artillery sometimes incorrectly reporting amount of barrages left
- Added voice line right after artillery fires about running out of ammo
- Various bug fixes with threading
- Moved briefing, log and field manual aside when playing very wide maps
- Added another video and newspaper article to Ortona historical documents about Victoria Cross recipient


If you're having problems with speech recognition, please refer to this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1011610/discussions/0/2262438048225838980


[h3]WHAT NEXT?[/h3]
This is our second big free content update. Where do you want to see the game go next? Let us know in the steam discussion forums, or on our discord.

notes.title: Free content update: CHALLENGE mode unlocked & voice commands for Linux!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch v2.0 - CHALLENGE MODE & voice commands now available for Linux![/h1]

Hitler died 75 years ago to this day (April 30, 1945), so it's a fitting time to launch our first major free content update. Whether you're a green recruit or a grizzled veteran, there's never been another time to begin (another) tour of duty!

[h2]CHALLENGE MODE[/h2]
We've added a new challenge mode option to all missions to up the difficulty (not for the faint of heart!). Instead of simply increasing enemy damage by 30% like most games, each scenario has a unique and hand-crafted difficulty added to it. For example, in Leonforte the enemy now has artillery, and the towns have additional fortifications. For the Hitler Line, expect a new fierce armoured counter-attack when you breach their line is breached! Beat all of of the missions in challenge mode to unlock a new steam achievement!

[h2]VOICE COMMANDS HAVE COME TO LINUX![/h2]
Let us know how it works for you!

[h2]SPEECH RECOGNITION IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Your voice is more powerful than ever! Thanks to everyone who donated their voice data, speech recognition performance has been improved for both US and UK speech models all across the board (but most specifically for problem terms "HOW", "JULIETT" and "FIRE BARRAGE AT").


[h2]Major[/h2]
- Hand-crafted CHALLENGE MODE difficulty option for all missions
- Voice commands now available for Linux!
- Speech recognition performance improved thanks to user-donated speech data! (specifically "HOW", "JULIETT" and "FIRE BARRAGE AT")
- Added 'Retry' button to pause menu

[h2]Map Editor[/h2]
- Made it so you can't save maps without entering a filename
- Fixed error saving map editor maps without administrator access

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Hitler Line: topmost enemy infantry replaced with AT-gun, added foxholes to towns themselves, altered nothern road
- Operation TONGA: added extra tank squadron to enemy counter-attack, made existing enemy tanks head to central town of Robehomme instead of stopping in Varaville, switched all units to dynamic AI for counter-attack
- Made AI tanks less content to garrison objectives (they'd rather attack)
- Minefields are now cleared if they deal a certain amount of damage (the enemy's triggered most of the mines)
- Falaise Gap: added road in south east of map

[h2]Minor[/h2]
- Made AI counter-attacks use more available units (as opposed to only using the minimum required)
- Enlarged map compass text directions
- Removed unnecessary free-play option for tutorials
- Made units retreating out of mission from reaching objective landmark capture landmark before leaving


What's next? The next big free content update is scheduled for the anniversary of the D-Day landings (June 6th). Stay tuned!

If you're having problems with speech recognition, please refer to this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1011610/discussions/0/2262438048225838980

You can help us improve the speech recognition! We've added a toggle to the bottom-right of the main-menu that records your voice commands. We'd be grateful if you help us improve the speech recognition performance on your bizarre accents.

We're working hard to make the game the best it can be, so good or bad, please leave a review with your thoughts and comments.

You asked, and we answered - we've been monitoring and responding to discord and the community forums like a hawk, and a new patch addressing many concerns is now live! This is what we call aggressive patching.

You may need to restart steam to pick up the patch.

Patch v1.01

Major features:
- Added 'extra mission duration' toggle to level-select screen. This doubles the duration for each operation, allowing you to take it slow and maneuver to your heart's content.
- Added 'slow game speed' toggle to level-select screen. This halves the normal game speed, slowing down the game and allowing you to more easily react to the craziness of war.
Note: Both options above only available for singleplayer (for now).

Minor:
- Removed the 'look at me' red circle animation of message prompts after it happens twice
- Made units be able to retreat when under fire even if they can't see their attacker (a.k.a. someone shooting your tanks, and your tanks can't see them)
- Tweaked AI to add maximum distance they'll move to capture empty enemy-held objectives (no more cross-map marathons!)

Bug fixes:
- Resized main menu and options menu to better support super widescreen (3440x1440)
- Fixed scan-lines/grayscale remaining when quitting a mission while fast-forwarding via pause menu
- Fixed drum-roll sound not stopping when a max-veterancy unit is levelled-up
- Removed font warnings from player.log file
- Changed saved replay filenames to use given names instead of mission name
- MULTIPLAYER: Fixed client being unable to report enemy status using enemy figurines

What's next? A straight-line/move directly to command, localization improvements, a map editor guide, more bug fixes and maybe trading cards?

If you're having problems with speech recognition, please refer to this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1011610/discussions/0/2262438048225838980


We're working hard to make the game the best it can be, so good or bad, please leave a review with your thoughts and comment.

notes.title: Radio General review
notes.notes:
Developer: Foolish Mortals
Publisher: Foolish Mortals
Release: Out now
On: Windows
From: Steam
Price: £15

Is now the moment to commit my reserve? Should I send my infantry down the road or through the forest? Do I have sufficient resources to take both villages or should I settle for just one? Many of the questions Radio General asks are as old as the Apennines. You will have encountered them countless times before. It’s novel noggin warmers like “Where on earth is Easy Company?”, “Do I have time for a quick puff on my pipe?” and “How do you tell a mother that she’ll never see her son again?” that mark out designer Michael Long as a revolutionary not a reiterator.
